notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: The Duffin Zoning Map And Land Use Map Amendment Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on September 24, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: The Duffin Zoning Map And Land Use Map Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 267 W. 11915 S. The purpose of the request is to Change the current zoning designation from R3 (Single-family residential) to CBP (Business/manufacturing park) and change the existing land use designation from Residential Medium Density to Business & Light Manufacturing.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on October 8, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Nick Whittaker at (801) 576-6522 or Nick.Whittaker@draperutah.gov 

Dated this 24th Day of September, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: Planning Commission Agenda
notices.agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA

Thursday, September 24, 2026, 6:30 PM 
1020 East Pioneer Road
Draper, UT 84020 Council Chambers

6:30 PM BUSINESS MEETING

1.	Items for Commission Consideration

1.a	Action Item: Selection of a new Draper City Planning Commission Vice-Chair

1.b	Action Item: Approve Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for August 27, 2026 (Administrative Action)
Approval of Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for August 27, 2026.

1.c	Public Hearing: Rivian KMAC-CSD Text Amendment (Legislative Item) On the request of Logan Johnson, representing Wright Development Group and Smith Payne Lone Peak, LLC. for a zoning text amendment to the KMAC-CSD zone. Known as application 2026-0169-TA. Staff Contact: Todd Draper, (801) 576-6335, todd.draper@draperutah.gov.

1.d	Public Meeting: The Grange Plat Amendment Request (Administrative Item)
On the request of Steven Gomm, property owner, a Subdivision Plat Amendment Request for approximately 0.99 acres located at 603 E. 12000 South. Known as application 2026-0009-SUB. Staff contact: Maryann DeHaven, (801) 576-6391, maryann.dehaven@drapertutah.gov.

1.e	Public Hearing: Academy Plaza Site Plan Request (Administrative Action)
On the request of Joe Johnsen of J Development, representing Dumar, LLC, a request for approval of a Site Plan for development of office/warehouse and vertical mixed-use buildings on approximately 7.69 acres located at approximately 421 West 13490 South, known as Application No.: 2026-0085-SP. Staff contact: Todd Taylor, (801) 576-6510, todd.taylor@draperutah.gov.

1.f	Public Hearing: Fratto Subdivision Plat Amendment Request (Administrative Item)
On the request of Troy Dana, a subdivision Plat Amendment for 2.03 acres located at approximately 791 E. 12200 S. Known as Application 2026-0100-SUB. Staff Contact: Nick Whittaker, 801-576-6522, Nick.Whittaker@draperutah.gov.

1.g	Public Hearing: Bangerter Crossroads Site Plan Request (Administrative Item)
On the request of Troy Wolverton of AWA Engineering, representing Lloyd's TLC Limited for approval of a Site Plan for approximately 12 Acres, located at approximately 13782 S. 300 E. Known as file 2026-0106-SP. Staff Contact: Todd Draper, (801) 576-6335, todd.draper@draperutah.gov.

1.h	Public Hearing: Pony Express Center Parking Deviation Request (Administrative Item)
On the request of Marina Miles of Rio Management Group representing MKH Properties Co., LLC, a Parking Deviation Request for approximately
3.38 acres of property located at approximately 12896 S. Pony Express Rd. Known as application 2025-0118-VAR. Staff Contact: Todd Draper, (801) 576-6335, todd.draper@draperutah.gov.
This Item has been continued to the October 8, 2026 Planning Commission Meeting.

2.	Other Business

2.a	Coordination between City Staff and Planning Commission (as needed).

3.	Adjournment
 
I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper Planning Commission meeting to be held September 24, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.

Nicole Smedley, CMC, City Recorder Draper City, State of Utah
